description: This Java class 'AttributesCreatedStrategy' implements a strategy for handling 'AttributesCreated' events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and modifies a 'ThingBuilder' object based on the event.

classes.name: AttributesCreatedStrategy
classes.description: Final class that extends 'AbstractThingEventStrategy' to handle 'AttributesCreated' events and update 'ThingBuilder' instances accordingly.

methods.name: applyEvent(AttributesCreated event, ThingBuilder.FromCopy thingBuilder)
methods.description: Overrides a method to process the 'AttributesCreated' event and update the 'ThingBuilder' with new attributes.
